<style lang="scss" scoped>
$folderColor: #70a1ff;
$paperColor: #ffffff;

.folder {
  transition: all 0.2s ease-in;

  &__back {
    position: relative;
    width: 100px;
    height: 80px;
    background: darken($folderColor, 8%);
    border-radius: 0px 5px 5px 5px;

    //The thing on the left top
    &::after {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 98%; //if 100% you can see a little gap on Chrome
      left: 0;
      content: '';
      width: 30px;
      height: 10px;
      background: darken($folderColor, 8%);
      border-radius: 5px 5px 0 0;
    }

    .paper {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 10%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, 10%);
      width: 70%;
      height: 80%;
      background: darken($paperColor, 10%);
      border-radius: 5px;
      transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out;

      //make paper bigger and bigger

      &:nth-child(2) {
        background: darken($paperColor, 5%);
        width: 80%;
        height: 70%;
      }

      &:nth-child(3) {
        background: darken($paperColor, 0%);
        width: 90%;
        height: 60%;
      }
    }

    .folder__front {
      position: absolute;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      background: $folderColor;
      border-radius: 5px;
      transform-origin: bottom;
      transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out;
    }
  }

  &:hover {
    transform: translateY(-8px);
  }

  &:hover .paper {
    transform: translate(-50%, 0%);
  }

  //there are 2 parts for the front of folder
  //one goes left and another goes right

  &:hover .folder__front {
    transform: skew(15deg) scaleY(0.6);
  }

  &:hover .right {
    transform: skew(-15deg) scaleY(0.6);
  }
}
</style>
